articles.title: Letter: the Foxglove Heights Neighbors Did a Good Job This Fall
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the January meeting.

Please keep the neighborhood watch sign program in the budget. Many of us on Vine Court use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Vine Court for 9 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foxglove Heights Neighbors has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the January meeting.
Mariana Demetriou, Tannery Flats
